summary: A Depth subscription: a full packet's ltt is its last trade time, not its exchange time (audit RB-07); a later full packet clears the book and has no trade, so it carries five empty levels and no ltt.

notes: Times from audit WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md RB-07 (exchange 1791002705000, trade 1791002699000).

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358); the desktop's common carrier has no such field, so it is lost.
deviations.ref: audit C06; WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md 'Verified broker fields dropped' (mstock)

deviations.reason: The web sends the previous close twice, as close and as prev_close (mstock_adapter.py:367-368); the desktop sends close only, and its dialect table has no prev_close alias for mStock.
The web sends the full packet's upper circuit limit in Depth (mstock_adapter.py:425); the desktop decodes it (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs:151) but the common carrier drops it.
deviations.ref: audit C06; RB matrix 'Verified broker fields dropped' (mstock)

deviations.reason: The web sends the full packet's lower circuit limit in Depth (mstock_adapter.py:426); the desktop decodes it (brokers/mstock/streaming.rs:152) but the common carrier drops it.
